subject: Clarifying SOC 2 control artifacts and ingestion for Sentinel RFP
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@sentinel.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@sentinel.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 artifacts - clarity on mapping and log delivery

Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As we move Sentinel's RFP evaluation into controls review, our security team has two asks so we can close the evidence loop fast:

1) A completed control mapping (your template is fine) that maps Redwood's implementation to Common Criteria for SOC 2 CC and the SIG taxonomy we provided.
2) A clear path for ingesting sample log artifacts: we prefer an S3 push or temporary presigned-upload; sampling window should be configurable.

Attached is the initial SIG matrix we sent earlier — please confirm the fields you need in the mapping.xlsx and whether you can provide redacted samples for sensitive controls (KMS, key rotation).

Target for artifacts: two-week window once mapping is agreed. Can your team nominate a collector/owner we can coordinate with for an upload slot and consent DocuSign?

Thanks,
Alex
Security Program Manager
Sentinel Systems
[Attachment: SIG_Request_Matrix.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@sentinel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts - clarity on mapping and log delivery

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers up front:
- We will fill your SIG/SOC2 mapping into the attached template (SOC2_Control_Mapping_Template.xlsx).
- For logs, our recommended path is a presigned S3 upload to a short-lived bucket per deal; we also support an SFTP drop if required by procurement.
- Redacted samples for KMS and rotation artifacts: yes, we can provide a redacted example (no private keys).

Next steps I propose:
1) We drop the mapping template in the S3 folder linked below and populate columns for control owner, artifact name, evidence path, and retention note.
2) Karthik (cc'd) will follow up with a technical doc describing the collector (the collector is a small agent we run from our side to pull logs or accept uploads).
3) We queue a 60-minute control walk on Monday to walk your assurance folks through the mapping and the upload process.

I'll add Karthik and Neha for orchestration and to confirm timing.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Control_Mapping_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@sentinel.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts - clarity on mapping and log delivery

Alex / Rafael,

Technical clarifications below (summary + minimal action items):

Summary:
- Collector options: 1) Presigned S3 upload (preferred), 2) SFTP drop, 3) Temporary read-only cross-account role if Sentinel wants inbound pull.
- Supported artifact formats: gzipped JSON logs, CSV access logs, PEM-wrapped rotations metadata (no private material).
- Sampling guidance: define a rolling 7-14 day window, we recommend 3 non-consecutive days for variety.

Action items:
- Sentinel to confirm preferred transfer method (S3 upload or cross-account role) and sample window.
- Sentinel to sign the evidence consent via DocuSign (link in my follow-up).
- We will provide a collector-instructions.pdf with steps, IAM policy snippets, and verification checklist.

Security notes: uploads land encrypted server-side with role-scoped keys; retention policy is configurable per deal and will be deleted 30 days after the intake unless otherwise stated in contract.

I'll prepare the collector doc and a sample IAM policy by Monday.

-karthik
Sr. Applied Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: collector-instructions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@sentinel.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@sentinel.com>, procurement@sentinel.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts - clarity on mapping and log delivery

Thanks team — this is helpful. A couple refinements from our side:

- We prefer a presigned S3 upload. Please provide the exact path/policy so we can route through our cloud security.
- For the sample window, we'll do 2028-02-20 to 2028-02-27 and will include the following artifact types: access logs, auth logs, audit trail CSVs. Size estimate ~600MB compressed.
- We need the mapping completed and returned no later than 2028-03-26 to meet our audit committee schedule.
- Procurement requests a short paper trail: please send a DocuSign consent packet that names Redwood personnel who will access artifacts.

We're fine with redacted keys; the primary ask is demonstrable proof of rotation timestamps, role binding changes, and that event ingestion pipelines have immutable audit IDs.

Alex
Security Program Manager
Sentinel Systems
[Attachment: access-logs-sample.zip (archive)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@sentinel.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts - clarity on mapping and log delivery

Alex —

Thanks for confirming. Quick execution plan and owners:

1) Mapping: Rafael to complete SOC2_Control_Mapping_Template.xlsx and upload to S3 folder by 2028-03-24. (Owner: rafael_mendes)
2) Collector setup: Karthik will publish presigned S3 instructions and IAM policy snippets tomorrow; collector-instructions.pdf will be in the same S3 folder. (Owner: karthik_iyer)
3) DocuSign: Marissa will prepare a consent packet listing the named Redwood engineers (minimal access scope). Expect DocuSign Monday morning so Sentinel procurement can sign. (Owner: marissa_cole)
4) Sample ingestion window: Once we have the upload, Neha will validate data integrity and provide a checksum/verification report within 24 hours of upload. (Owner: neha_kapoor)

Timeline check: we will meet your 2028-03-26 mapping deadline provided the DocuSign is signed by 2028-03-23 and Sentinel confirms the upload method tonight. If there are any constraints on the S3 policy from your cloud security, send them to me and we will adapt.

I'll populate the mapping file with control owners and expected artifact filenames so your team has a one-to-one reference.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai
